findings.title: Full-domain driver runs the orchestrator as a flat parallel domain
evidence: tools/full_domain.py:118-150 master_order()/select() treat 00 as one entry; no wave/verify gating
prompts/MASTER_RUNNER_FULL_HARDENING.md:34-77 defines sequential Wave 0 then parallel domain fan-out
findings.impact: The orchestration semantics (sequencing, claim sampling, verification gates) of prompt 00 are not implemented by the driver; only report emission is.
findings.recommendation: Either implement wave ordering/verification gates in `full_domain.py` or document explicitly that 00 is advisory when the driver is used.

report: Reviewed `tools/full_domain.py` against the master runner's wave model (`prompts/MASTER_RUNNER_FULL_HARDENING.md:34-77`) and the 00 prompt. `domains --full` parsed 42 prompt domains plus the deterministic lens.
